definitions.explanation: The way in which something is spread out over an area or among a group.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分布|ぶんぷ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This plant is distributed throughout Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧{分布|ぶんぷ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I investigated the changes in population distribution.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分布|ぶんぷ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: To show the distribution of data in a graph.

notes:
{分布|ぶんぷ} is used in scientific, geographical, and statistical contexts to describe how things are spread out.

Common collocations:
- {分布|ぶんぷ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be distributed)
- {分布|ぶんぷ}⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (distribution map)
- ⟦{地理的|ちりてき}→地理的：27297_chiriteki⟧{分布|ぶんぷ} (geographical distribution)
- ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧{分布|ぶんぷ} (normal distribution - statistics)

Usage contexts:
- Biology: species distribution
- Geography: population distribution
- Statistics: data distribution
- Chemistry: molecular distribution
